ctx.x: Every night we was playing on this boat and you know we stopped at each town every night and give a dance right on the boat -- the boat ride -- you know. On the trip down to Missouri and up to Illinois.

And every night we had a -- we had a swell arranger on that band -- in that band too, named Jessfe Stone (PHONETIC). And Jessfe Stone was way ahead of everybody really. He was a very great arranger and a piano player. In fact he was an all around good musician.

You know -- and I guess he's still living -- I think he is. And I got a wire from Blanche Calloway (PHONETIC)- to join her in Memphis. So I -- things looked kinda slow for the band -- you know. We wasn't getting much money on this boat thing you know.
